import odoolib,json
c=odoolib.get_connection(hostname='127.0.0.1',protocol='json2',port=8069,database='bench',password=open('/etc/odoo/api_key').read().strip())
def q(m,d,f): return c.get_model(m).search_read(domain=d,fields=f,limit=1000)
print('COMPONENT_OFFERS',json.dumps(q('product.supplierinfo',[('product_tmpl_id','in',[3,4,5,6,7])],['id','partner_id','product_tmpl_id','min_qty','price','delay']),default=str))
print('COMPONENT_POS',json.dumps(q('purchase.order',[('id','<=',18)],['id','name','partner_id','state','origin','date_planned','order_line']),default=str))
print('WC_USED_TIME',json.dumps(q('mrp.workorder',[],['id','production_id','workcenter_id','duration_expected','state']),default=str))
print('MODELS',json.dumps({m:[x for x in c.get_model(m).fields_get().keys() if x in ['date_start','date_finished','date_planned','origin','workcenter_id','production_id','product_qty','product_uom_qty','state']] for m in ['purchase.order','purchase.order.line','mrp.production','mrp.workorder']}))
